cases.case_label: Truncated AluSx-like (~115 bp) at MLH1 c.588+8 in intron 7
cases.mechanism_detail: A ~115-bp 3'-fragment of AluSx with poly(A) inserted 8 bp into intron 7 duplicates the exon 7 donor; the Alu sequence is spliced into MLH1 mRNA after exon 7 and transcription appears to terminate at the Alu poly(A), so no exon 7-8 or downstream (exon 14-17) product is amplified from the mutant allele.
cases.quote: Functional studies demonstrated that the AluSx‐like element led to complete disruption of mRNA splicing and probably resulted in transcriptional termination at the poly (A) region of the AluSx‐like insertion.
